target.reuse_status: reused V39 guide; not fresh or architecture-held-out

design.type: paired 2x2 factorial within three candidate seeds
design.objective: unchanged V39 first-block JVP objective with V36 core.fit
design.fixture_controls: fresh adaptation and challenge streams; prior V2 identities exclusion-only; predictions sealed before oracle evaluation; disjoint from inherited exclusions and V39 fixtures

primary_metric.name: pooled training-direction JVP nRMSE on adaptation and donor tokens
primary_metric.support_rule: geometric-mean paired error ratio <= 0.80 and all three seed-level paired ratios favor the factor

factorial_results.interpretation: Longer optimization improved adaptation training-direction fit under the frozen criterion. The capacity effect did not meet that criterion. Neither factor yielded held-out causal retention.

controls: wrong seed module at matched capacity and update budget
heldout_gates.candidate_pass_rule: all gates and all three control-sensitivity comparisons pass in every stratum for that seed
heldout_gates.retention_pass_rule: one predeclared factorial cell passes for all three seeds

heldout_by_stratum.aggregation: median across the 12 candidate-by-seed rows in each stratum; control count is number of rows meeting all required margins

best_factorial_cell_diagnostic.interpretation: best observed factorial cell, but it does not pass the predeclared all-seed retention rule

reproduction_closeout.runtime: Python 3.12.13, macOS 26.6.1 arm64, CPU, one thread; Torch 2.6.0, NumPy 2.4.6, Transformers 5.17.0

custody.custody_statement: Prompts, token IDs, guide assets, captures, candidates, predictions and oracle arrays remain on PrimaryED; runtimes remain on Backup ED. No raw experimental payloads are copied into this repository.

limitations: same owner and physical host for primary and replica
one reused Spanish-trained GPT-2 guide and one MLP site
three candidate seeds are not independent guide checkpoints
no fresh checkpoint, architecture-held-out result, blind external replication, or independent review
energy and full economic cost were not measured
nonclaims: no architecture-general theorem or all-architecture result
no whole-model mechanistic identity beyond the measured local interventions
no novelty, consciousness, human-alignment equivalence, independent acceptance, or production authorization
next_blocked_authority_gate: Configured independent authority for stronger scientific acceptance; production requires separate operational authorization.
next_research_step: Do not extend optimizer or width sweeps as a presumed fix. Any next local packet needs a distinct causal-transfer hypothesis, frozen predictions, fresh disjoint fixtures, and unchanged held-out gates.
